user.title: Consumption Forecast
user.description: Select the input entities, the forecast model and the parameters used to train it. Models other than the built-in one are provided by the Consumption Forecast Model Provider add-on; without it the built-in profile model is used.

data.history_days: Training window in days (leave empty to use all available history)
data.export_entity: Grid export / sold energy (optional, cumulative kWh)
data.peak_hours: How many highest/lowest hours per day to flag (0 = off)

error.invalid_timezone: Unknown timezone. Use an IANA name such as Europe/Helsinki.

data.history_days: Training window in days (leave empty to use all available history)
data.export_entity: Grid export / sold energy (optional, cumulative kWh)
data.peak_hours: How many highest/lowest hours per day to flag (0 = off)

error.invalid_timezone: Unknown timezone. Use an IANA name such as Europe/Helsinki.

train_model.name: Train model
train_model.description: Force an immediate retrain from the recorded history.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: Which configuration to retrain. Leave empty for all.

refresh_forecast.name: Refresh forecast
refresh_forecast.description: Recompute the forecast immediately using the current model.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: Which configuration to refresh. Leave empty for all.

forecast_period.name: Forecast period
forecast_period.description: Forecast consumption over an arbitrary period from a start, end and a single outdoor temperature. Returns hourly values, daily sums and the period total as response data.

start.name: Start
start.description: Start of the period (inclusive; minutes ignored).

end.name: End
end.description: End of the period (exclusive; minutes ignored).

outdoor_temp.name: Outdoor temperature
outdoor_temp.description: Outdoor temperature in °C, applied to every hour in the period.

target_temp.name: Target temperature
target_temp.description: Thermostat target in °C. Defaults to current target if omitted.

entry_id.name: Config entry
entry_id.description: Which configuration to use. Required only with more than one entry.
